documents.title: Veltrixamine in adults with synthetic glimmer syndrome
documents.text: Adults with synthetic glimmer syndrome received veltrixamine 40 mg daily. The glimmer score improved by 12 points compared with placebo at 12 weeks.
documents.finding: The glimmer score improved by 12 points compared with placebo at 12 weeks.

documents.title: Follow-up report of veltrixamine in adults with synthetic glimmer syndrome
documents.text: This follow-up reports the same adults with synthetic glimmer syndrome on veltrixamine 40 mg daily. The glimmer score stayed improved by 11 points compared with placebo at 24 weeks.
documents.finding: The glimmer score stayed improved by 11 points compared with placebo at 24 weeks.

documents.title: Veltrixamine in children with synthetic glimmer syndrome
documents.text: Children with synthetic glimmer syndrome received veltrixamine 10 mg daily. The glimmer score did not improve compared with placebo at 12 weeks.
documents.finding: The glimmer score did not improve compared with placebo at 12 weeks.

documents.title: Orbalin in adults with synthetic ember fatigue
documents.text: Adults with synthetic ember fatigue received orbalin 5 mg daily. The ember score improved by 8 points compared with placebo at 8 weeks.
documents.finding: The ember score improved by 8 points compared with placebo at 8 weeks.

documents.title: Orbalin in adults with synthetic ember fatigue, second trial
documents.text: Adults with synthetic ember fatigue received orbalin 5 mg daily in a second trial. The ember score did not improve compared with placebo at 8 weeks.
documents.finding: The ember score did not improve compared with placebo at 8 weeks.

documents.title: Quenzil in adults with synthetic hollow cough
documents.text: Adults with synthetic hollow cough received quenzil 20 mg daily. The cough score improved by 6 points compared with placebo at 4 weeks.
documents.finding: The cough score improved by 6 points compared with placebo at 4 weeks.

documents.title: Tessarine in adults with synthetic marble rash
documents.text: Adults with synthetic marble rash received tessarine 15 mg daily. The rash score improved by 4 points compared with placebo at 6 weeks.
documents.finding: The rash score improved by 4 points compared with placebo at 6 weeks.
